voice_description.texture: clear, smooth, polished studio vocal with crisp high-end presence and zero rasp
voice_description.emotional_tone: problem-solving, informative, authoritative yet empathetic in the problem setup, transitioning to reassuring, confident, and direct for the CTA
voice_description.delivery_pace: moderate and articulate commercial pace (around 160-170 words per minute), featuring deliberate punchy phrasing and rhythmic cadences

music.description: Modern commercial underscore consisting of synth pulses, subtle sub-bass drops, electronic percussion, and airy melodic pads.

timeline.description: Tense, investigative bed with muted rhythmic synth pulses, subtle deep bass thumps, and low atmospheric drones matching the problem-agitation script.
Uplifting transition with an ambient riser into an optimistic, rhythmic corporate electronic bed featuring light synth plucks and steady mid-tempo pulsing.
Sustained driving electronic pulse maintaining momentum and clarity behind product benefits.
Resolution riser leading to a clean, punctuated outro bass pad and synth chime tail fading out.

sound_effects.description: Low sub-bass boom / impact hit on opening beat.
Quick whoosh / swish transition into 'Here's the trap...'
Subtle bass drop / impact accentuating 'It works... for a day.'
Swoosh riser accentuating 'That's the loop' into the product reveal.
Impact hit / transition sweep underneath the final 'GLP-1 SOS' product name.
Clean digital UI tap / click SFX on 'Tap below.'

pauses_and_emphasis.phrase: On a GLP-1, the harder you push your gut with laxatives, the more stuck you get.
Here's the trap no one warns you about.
pauses_and_emphasis.notes: Clear pause before, stressed 'trap' and 'no one'.
Dramatic micro-pause between 'works' and 'for a day' to undercut temporary relief.
Standalone concluding phrase followed by a brief pause before introducing the solution.

pauses_and_emphasis.phrase: Nothing to force, nothing to get hooked on.
pauses_and_emphasis.notes: Symmetrical rhythmic stress on 'Nothing to force' and 'hooked on'.

pauses_and_emphasis.phrase: GLP-1 SOS. 60-day money-back guarantee. Tap below.
pauses_and_emphasis.notes: Segmented, punchy call-to-action cadence with clear silence separating each statement.

voice_continuity: Consistent studio mic placement and proximity effect throughout; seamless vocal chain with transparent compression, tight gating/de-breathing, and steady gain structure across all edits.

ending.audio_tail: Music decay and synth tail ring out cleanly until final fade-out at 01:05.8 - 01:06.0.

practical_narration_direction: Deliver the opening warning with measured, conspiratorial authority—do not rush the negative diagnosis. Use distinct micro-pauses around contrasting phrases ('It works... for a day') to let the frustration land. Pivot at 'GLP-1 SOS' into a lighter, solution-oriented clinical tone that feels reassuring rather than aggressive, ending with brisk, definitive punch on the offer and call-to-action.
